title: Graphs at a glance
lines: | Ogive | cumulative f at upper boundaries
! Unequal widths: bar height = f ÷ width.

title: Averages: formulas
lines: - G.M. = nth root of the product; log G.M. = Σlog x ÷ n
- A.M. > G.M. > H.M. for unequal positive values

title: Median and mode, grouped
lines: ! L is a class boundary, not a class limit.

title: Shape and the three averages
lines: | Positive skew (right tail) | mean > median > mode
| Negative skew (left tail) | mean < median < mode
! Memory aid: the mean runs after the tail.

title: Dispersion formulas
lines: - Range = xₘ − x₀; coefficient = (xₘ − x₀) ÷ (xₘ + x₀)
- C.V. = (σ ÷ x̄) × 100; lower C.V. = more consistent
- Normal curve: Q.D. ≈ ⅔σ, M.D. ≈ ⅘σ

title: Changing the data
lines: | Median, mode | change the same way
| S.D. | σ × size of a (sign dropped)
! Adding b moves the centre but never the spread.

title: Skewness and kurtosis
lines: - Pearson: Sk = (mean − mode) ÷ σ = 3(mean − median) ÷ σ
! Lepto = slender, platy = flat (like a plate).

title: Index numbers
lines: - Chain index = previous chain × link relative ÷ 100
! Laspeyres looks back to base-year quantities; Paasche uses the present.

title: Counting rules
lines: - ⁿPᵣ = n! ÷ (n − r)!: order matters (posts, arrangements)
- ⁿCᵣ = n! ÷ [r!(n − r)!]: order does not matter (committees)
- Letters with p alike: n! ÷ p!
! Ask: does swapping two people give a new result? Yes → P, no → C.

title: Laws of probability
lines: - P(A ∪ B) = P(A) + P(B) − P(A ∩ B)
- Bayes: P(B₁ | A) = P(B₁)P(A | B₁) ÷ ΣP(Bᵢ)P(A | Bᵢ)

title: Dice, coins and cards
lines: | Two dice | 36 outcomes; sum 7 in 6 ways
| Two dice | sums 2 and 12 in 1 way each

title: Distributions
lines: - Binomial: P(X = r) = ⁿCᵣ pʳ qⁿ⁻ʳ
- Poisson: P(X = r) = e⁻ᵐ mʳ ÷ r!
! Binomial variance is always less than its mean; Poisson's equals it.

title: Sampling and testing
lines: - Samples: Nⁿ with replacement, ᴺCₙ without
- SE of mean = σ ÷ √n; SE of proportion = √(pq ÷ n)
- Type I: reject true H₀ (prob α). Type II: accept false H₀ (prob β)

title: Regression, correlation, time series
lines: - r² = b_yx × b_xy; r has their sign; −1 ≤ r ≤ 1
- Time series components: STCI = Secular trend, Seasonal (within a year), Cyclical (several years), Irregular (random)
